```
An installation serves a CLI of its own release alone. This asks yours which it runs, pulls
that release's CLI, and replaces this one once the release's signature and provenance say it is
what the release workflow built. Whichever release it runs is the one installed, an older one
included: it is the only one it serves.

A command the installation refuses for a CLI behind it does this by itself and runs again.

Usage:
  spin update [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for update

Global Flags:
      --config string        config file (default is $HOME/.spin/config.yaml)
  -o, --output string        text for a person, or json: one document of what the API answered, and no prose (default "text")
      --profile string       named profile to use; SPIN_PROFILE names it when this flag does not (default "default")
      --traceparent string   the W3C traceparent of the span this command is part of; its own span is sent to the installation unless the profile says telemetry: false
```
